name: Pollen Puff
description: If the target is an ally, this move restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded down, instead of dealing damage.
flags: Blocked by Detect, Protect, Spiky Shield, and if not a Status move, King's Shield.
Can be copied by Mirror Move.
The move plays its animation when used on an ally.
Has no effect on Pokemon with the Ability Bulletproof.
